description.part2: can see across Recent Leads, Lead List, and Campaigns.

default.title: See everything (default)
default.description: Sees every lead and every campaign, same as an admin.

counselor.title: Assigned to {{role}}
counselor.description: Recent Leads and Lead List rows are automatically scoped to leads where the user is the linked counselor. Campaigns are unaffected — {{role}} still sees every campaign.

audienceList.title: Granted audience lists only
audienceList.description: Sees only the explicitly granted audience lists, and only those lists' responses on Recent Leads.

grantedLists.label: Granted audience lists
grantedLists.empty: No audience lists found for this institute.
grantedLists.zeroSelectedWarning: No lists selected yet — this role won't see any leads until at least one is granted.

assignedOnly.title: Only show leads {{role}} owns
assignedOnly.description: Also narrows visibility to the leads {{role}} owns, with any lead they add by hand automatically stamped to them — so a lead never disappears from their view the moment they save it. Active only while the institute runs no counsellor pool.
assignedOnly.inertWarning_one: This institute already runs {{count}} counsellor pool, so this setting has no effect right now.
assignedOnly.inertWarning_other: This institute already runs {{count}} counsellor pools, so this setting has no effect right now.
